module: Node "Get Electrics Value" (category `once_f_duration`). Reads an `electrics` value of the vehicle: subscribes with `core_vehicleBridge.registerValueChangeNotification(veh, key)` then reads the cache `getCachedVehicleData`. Pins: inputs `vehId`, `key` (string, with predefined templates: throttle, throttle_input, rpm, brake, brake_input, parkingbrake, parkingbrake_input, gear, clutch...); output `value` (any). Uses the duration state (inactive, started, finished).
notes: The `key` template list is in `postInit` (excerpt here, longer in the code).
The node goes to `finished` as soon as a non-nil value is received; the notification is removed on reset/stop.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

_executionStopped.desc: Called by the manager when the project execution stops; cleans up the internal state.

clearNotification.desc: Unsubscribes from the value change notification (`unregisterValueChangeNotification`) and clears `_setupData`.

init.desc: Node constructor, called at its creation by the flowgraph editor/manager; initializes the internal state.

onNodeReset.desc: Goes to `inactive` duration and removes the notification.

postInit.desc: Defines `hardTemplates` of the `key` pin: list of common electrics keys offered in the editor.

work.desc: Reads the cached value; if it exists, writes it to `value` and goes to `finished`.

workOnce.desc: Subscribes to the vehicle's `key` value and goes to `started` duration.
